t: Created by the Bolsheviks in the October Revolution of 1917, it was the world’s first state committed to building socialism.
It won the Civil War and in 1922 co-founded the Soviet Union, holding about three-quarters of its territory.
In 1990–1991 it declared sovereignty, elected Boris Yeltsin president and became the Russian Federation.
dyk: The largest Soviet republic was the only one without its own Communist Party until 1990: Moscow feared that a Russian party would become a rival centre of power to the Union party.
ev: The Bolsheviks seize power in Petrograd in the October Revolution
The capital moves to Moscow and the first Soviet constitution is adopted
The Red Army defeats Wrangel’s last White army in Crimea
The RSFSR co-founds the Soviet Union
Germany invades; Leningrad is besieged and Moscow threatened
The RSFSR declares state sovereignty on 12 June
Boris Yeltsin is elected president and resists the August coup
The republic is renamed the Russian Federation on 25 December

f.founder: Vladimir Lenin and the Bolshevik Party
